commit_message:
feat(site): add SEO metadata, structured data, and crawler files

Base layout gains canonical URL, full Open Graph and Twitter card tags, and JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, and homepage SoftwareApplication with pricing offers). Legal footer and homepage links normalized to trailing-slash paths to match canonical URLs. Added robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, and a Netlify/Cloudflare _headers file with security headers; CSP is staged commented-out pending a live Paddle checkout verification.

Constraint: CSP left commented out in _headers until a live Paddle checkout is verified against the allowlist
Confidence: medium
Scope-risk: moderate
Not-tested: Astro build/dev not run to confirm JSON-LD renders correctly and trailing-slash links resolve without redirect loops
warnings: SLOP_PATCH_INVALID: retry produced no usable patch

findings.issue: organizationLd includes `sameAs: []`, an empty placeholder array with no real social links wired in. Dead field that serializes into the live JSON-LD output for no benefit; typical AI-authored placeholder left over from a template.
`logo: logo,` skips object shorthand for no reason (unlike every other key in the same literal). Trivial but a giveaway of unreviewed generated code.
Organization schema logo points at favicon.svg; schema.org/Google recommend a raster logo (png/jpg), svg may not validate in Rich Results.
findings.fix: Point logo at og-image.png or a dedicated raster logo asset.

findings.issue: URLs missing <lastmod>; reduces crawler freshness signal.
findings.fix: Add <lastmod> per entry if deploy pipeline can inject build date.

findings.issue: CSP left commented out pending manual Paddle checkout verification, so no CSP is active on deploy.
findings.fix: Track as follow-up task to verify and enable CSP before considering hardening complete.

historical.message:
feat(site): add SEO metadata, structured data, and crawl files

Harden the marketing site for search and social sharing. Add self-referencing
canonical, full Open Graph + Twitter summary_large_image tags, and a generated
1200x630 og-image.png so links unfurl with a real preview card. Emit JSON-LD
for Organization and WebSite sitewide and SoftwareApplication (Free/Pro offers)
on the homepage. Ship robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, and Netlify security
headers. Trim the homepage title/description to SERP limits and point internal
legal links at their trailing-slash canonical form to drop a 301 hop.

The Pro offer models the recurring price via UnitPriceSpecification (monthly),
not a flat amount, to match on-page pricing and avoid a rich-results mismatch.
Organization logo points at the square favicon, not the wide social banner.

Constraint: Netlify deploys from main; static Astro; Paddle checkout runs
client-side and must not break.
Rejected: shipping a live Content-Security-Policy (staged commented-out in
_headers to avoid blocking the Paddle checkout iframe/XHR until verified against
a real checkout); @astrojs/sitemap (peer-dep risk vs astro ^7) in favor of a
static sitemap.
Directive: fix upstream, no bandaids; deslop + code-review gates run pre-commit.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Not-tested: live social-unfurl rendering (Facebook Sharing Debugger, LinkedIn
Post Inspector, X/Slack/iMessage paste) requires the deployed URL; CSP remains
disabled pending a live Paddle checkout test.
